Items neufs, aucun repris du parent (jeans, sneakers, sweats, voiture, bracelets, pull). Format adapté : une chose par slide avec une phrase, aucune marque citée. Les lignes 9 et 10 (« niche ») sont sautées, accroches voisines de la ligne 8 le même jour..

slides.texte_overlay: A man who can cook for his friends without a recipe. A big pot of pasta, good music, everyone around the table.
Someone who knows the stars. Pointing out constellations on a summer night is one of the coolest quiet skills there is.
A well-worn leather jacket. The kind that looks better after ten years than on the first day. Character over trend.
People who travel slowly. A week in one small town instead of five cities in five days. You really get to know a place, its people and its food that way.
Knowing random fascinating facts. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and my friends love the stories I bring.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. My friends love the stories I bring.

slides.texte_overlay: A handwritten note left on someone's desk. Small, unexpected and remembered much longer than a text. Try it once.
Men who are calm on the road. No honking, no anger, just patience. It's rarer and cooler than any car. Patience is cool.
